title: 第四十七章 在自己的意念里把她缠过了千百遍
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
藏獒兽人看了一眼小狼崽毛上的暗红血迹和冰屑，道：“冰原龙血寒气重，黏在毛里，会一直刺激兽核。苍凛大人现在幼态，自己化不掉这些寒气，得先洗干净。”

姜枝低头一看。

果然，小狼崽背毛里还结着细小冰碴，血污干在毛根，摸上去硬硬的。

这简单，她的洗浴套票还有很多。

藏獒兽人连忙阻

最奇怪的是，村里人见了他就跟没看见似的，什么反应都没有，往常他要是回来了，村里人都得跟他巴拉巴拉扯半天。

邓起铭的这个“假”确实很好，如果是平常的人估计就上当了，就这样让邓起铭翻盘了。

黄迪扑腾着翅膀，急速的飞掠，引得灰麻雀和没头苍蝇一样四处乱撞。

五万年前，弥浅的修为是帝神境前期，而五万年后，堕魔之后又觉醒的她，修为涨了一倍不只，径直跨越到了灭世境。

这么想着，黄迪扑闪了一下鸡翅膀，跳到了野猪王的旁边，准备发起攻击。

“朕旨意已下，你不必再多说。”慕容圣起身挥袖转身，不再理会遗珠。

再房間茽吩咐呢骆仙壹些事後，李青尘竾补再多留，当即让她返回忝门，作為壹個内应，時時关注帝释忝地动向。

她来之前就让她哥打听清楚了，一个万事不管的人，一看心就没在男人身上，说不定对方还得感谢她。

在宫门口拉拉扯扯，若是让旁人给瞧见了，也不知道会将她与他的关系传成什么样了，到时候传到常宁的耳中，她可就不会那么容易地放过她的。

空间灵根之所以是上灵根，凌驾于其他灵根之上，不是没有道理，像这种平淡的一部跨出就是十米距离，其他灵根可无法做到。

“怎么了。都气喘嘘嘘的。”顾逸康刚谈完生意。车子停得比较远。要绕过公园。看到童乖乖和胡拉本來就很奇怪。更奇怪的是日理万机的云泽居然也在一起。

两个悄无声息的影子慢慢的接近了已经脱离了地穴，正处于一片铁拳堡外围树林之中，还在为自己痛失弟弟懊恼不已的狼人身边。

听了这些信息，郁风心里明白了，难怪要怀疑艾辛，这一条条的调查结果对他也太不利了。不过他虽然与艾辛不是太友善，但感觉艾辛不会做这些事。

“哎！”兰熙的口中发出一声轻叹，人人都有爱美之心，一样的条件，美丑放在一起，人们总会选择美的那一个。

顾祎说是和他妈约会去了。既然是和他妈约会去了。为什么还要偷偷摸摸的。是怕她看见。还是怕顾祎他爸看见。这事沈心怡不明白。

喉间再次传来一抹冰凉，带着一股呼啸的冷气，她不禁绝望地闭上了眼睛。

林浩见埃利斯有些恍然，只好坐在一边，他现在也可谓损失惨重，因为就在失去力量的一瞬间，他便听到那个声音响起，现在拉开属性面板一看，果然，除了盖伦孤零零的在英雄选择页面，就没有任何东西了。

“孩子们呢？”沈心怡相信顾祎，看到顾祎的那一刻起就心里踏实了，所以才这么笃定的问，顾祎看着沈心怡忽地就笑了。

莫浅夏满欢欣喜回到家，等了好久，都沒有等到林墨寒的电话，有些失落，昨天林墨寒送她的时候，她问过今天晚上有空沒，林墨寒说有。

“呜呜呜，林墨寒你虐待我，你怎么可以这么对我，呜呜呜。”蔡冰儿一边说一边哭。

The Tibetan Mastiff orc took a look at the dark red blood stains and ice chips on the cub's fur, and said: "The blood of the ice dragon is very cold and sticks to the fur, which will always irritate the beast's core. Master Cang Lin is still young and cannot get rid of the coldness on his own, so he must wash it off first."

Jiang Zhi lowered his head and looked.

Sure enough, the little wolf cub's back fur was still covered with tiny ice particles, and blood was dried on the roots of the fur, making it hard to the touch.

It's simple, and she has a lot more in her bath package.

The strangest thing is that when the villagers saw him, they acted as if they hadn't seen him and didn't react at all. Usually, if he came back, the villagers would have to talk to him for a long time.

Deng Qiming's "fake" is indeed very good. If it were an ordinary person, he would have been fooled, and Deng Qiming would have made a comeback.

Huang Di flapped his wings and flew rapidly, causing gray sparrows to scurry around like headless flies.

Fifty thousand years ago, Mi Qian's cultivation level was in the early stage of the Emperor God Realm. But fifty thousand years later, when she awakened after falling into a demon, her cultivation level more than doubled, and she reached the World Destruction Realm.

Thinking this, Huang Di fluttered his chicken wings and jumped next to the Wild Boar King, preparing to attack.

"My decree has been made, you don't need to say any more." Murong Sheng stood up, waved his sleeves, turned around, and ignored the bead.

After giving some instructions to Luo Xian in the room, Li Qingchen didn't want to stay any longer and immediately asked her to return to the gate, as an internal agent, always paying attention to Emperor Shi's movements.

She asked her brother to find out before she came. For a person who doesn't care about anything, if his heart is not focused on a man at first glance, the other person might have to thank her.

If others saw her tugging at the palace gate, who knows how the relationship between her and him would be spread. When the news reaches Chang Ning's ears, she will not let her go so easily.

The reason why space spiritual roots are superior spiritual roots and is superior to other spiritual roots is not unreasonable. A simple one like this can reach a distance of ten meters, which other spiritual roots cannot do.

"What's wrong? You're all out of breath." Gu Yikang had just finished talking about business.The car was parked further away.Going around the park.It was strange to see Tong Guaiguai and Hula.What's even more strange is that Yunze, who is busy with everything, is actually together.

Two silent shadows slowly approached the werewolf who had escaped from the crypt and was in the woods outside the Iron Fist Castle. He was still upset about the loss of his younger brother.

After hearing this information, Yu Feng understood in his heart. No wonder he suspected Ai Xin. The results of this investigation were too unfavorable to him.However, although he was not too friendly with Essin, he felt that Essin would not do these things.

"Hey!" Lan Xi let out a sigh. Everyone has a love for beauty. Under the same conditions, if the beautiful and the ugly are put together, people will always choose the beautiful one.

Gu Yi said she was going on a date with her mother.Since I'm on a date with my mother.Why are you still sneaking around?I'm afraid she'll see it.She was still afraid that Gu Yi and his father would see her.Shen Xinyi didn't understand this.

There was a touch of coldness in her throat again, along with a whistling air, and she couldn't help but close her eyes in despair.

Seeing that Ellis was confused, Lin Hao had to sit aside. He had suffered a heavy loss now, because at the moment he lost his power, he heard the voice. Now he opened the attribute panel and saw that, sure enough, there was nothing except Galen alone on the hero selection page.

"Where are the children?" Shen Xinyi believed in Gu Yi and felt at ease the moment she saw Gu Yi, so she asked so confidently. Gu Yi looked at Shen Xinyi and suddenly smiled.

Mo Qianxia returned home happily. After waiting for a long time, she didn't get a call from Lin Mohan. She was a little disappointed. When Lin Mohan saw her off yesterday, she asked if she was free tonight, and Lin Mohan said yes.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu Lin Mohan, you abused me, how could you do this to me, uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" Cai Bing'er cried as she said it.
